**eval:** the zero-call test tools (`brief-check.py`, `brief-zero-calls.py`, `probe-test.py`, `probe-translate.py`, `probe-loop.py`, `probe-equivalence.py`, `brief-bench.py`, `tool-census/score_brief.py`) read the public bench `eval/brief-bench/` by default, so a fresh checkout runs them. `--questions <file.jsonl>` names another question file; `--census-db <census.db>` opts into the private census, whose prompts stay out of the tree (`manifest.json` and `census.db*` are git-ignored). A question with no recorded no-brief run replays its bench baseline, or says `no recorded trace`. The census runner, scorer, oracle experiment and extractor now live in `scripts/bench/tool-census/`; `--root` defaults to `$PIXEL_CENSUS_ROOT`, else `$TMPDIR/pixel-tool-census`. Tasks #905, #906.
